survivors.claim: render-gate.js's --no-boot CLI flag was silently broken: the guard renderConfig.boot && !noBoot was changed to renderConfig.boot unconditionally, so boot always spawns regardless of --no-boot, while a new RENDER_GATE_NO_BOOT env var is threaded into the child that nothing reads.
survivors.impact: A CLI flag documented in the render gate's own usage line and contracted by the sibling spec now silently does nothing.
survivors.evidence: Executed repro: synthetic host with design.render.boot = 'touch boot-was-spawned.marker', ready='false', readyTimeout 1s; ran render-gate.js --no-boot; marker file WAS created despite --no-boot. grep -rn RENDER_GATE_NO_BOOT returns zero matches outside the write site.
